input.prompt: Reopen ticket #1003 (status: closed) and set it back to new.

Enforced since #61: zendesk_update_ticket and zendesk_update_tickets_bulk read the current status and refuse a forbidden transition before any write, force:true included, so the description's "Enforces ... valid status transitions" now holds in code and not only in the skill text.
